A review of a representative sample of surveys recently published in Natural Language Generation aims to provide the scientific community with a research roadmap to identify which NLG aspects are still not suitably addressed by LLMs, as well as suggest future lines of research that should be addressed going forward. ### Roadmap for Natural Language Generation: Challenges and Insights. ### Importance of Facts for Natural Language Generation. ### Faithfulness in Natural Language Generation: A Systematic Survey of Analysis, Evaluation and Optimization Methods. ### Natural Language Generation Using Sequential Models: A Survey. ### Evaluation in the context of natural language generation. What is involved in natural language generation, and how evaluation has figured in work in this area to date is described; a particular text generation application is examined and the issues that are raised in assessing its performance on a variety of dimensions are looked at. ### Evaluation in Natural Language Generation: Lessons from Referring Expression Generation. Several problems that arise in designing evaluation for this task are explored, and general considerations that need to be met in evaluating Natural Language Generation subtasks are identified. ### Natural Language Generation through Character-based RNNs with Finite-state Prior Knowledge. ### SHARED TASKS AND COMPARATIVE EVALUATION IN NATURAL LANGUAGE GENERATION. ### An Investigation into the Validity of Some Metrics for Automatically Evaluating Natural Language Generation Systems. ### EXPERIENCES WITH PLANNING FOR NATURAL LANGUAGE GENERATION. ### Natural Language Generation in Interactive Systems.
